releaseNotes:
Saving a payment that needs review now confirms it.

On Needs review you can reject one payment, or reject all of them after a confirmation.

Payments from different banks stay on their own accounts, so they are no longer grouped together.

On Reports you can choose which charts to show. Spending by category can show the top 5, the top 10, or every category. A money-out-by-bank chart is available when you turn it on.

Help & support opens the FFS questions on The Fox’s Den.
